tickets.signal: 28 Sep: GA calibration complete but Month 3 behind. GB data missing exports, 2 sensors with wrong start dates; only half of GC/GD received. IPMVP validation must come before AI policy training.

tickets.summary: [DayOne-NTPE][1.2] Chiller Plant Modelling + Cooling system topology mapping
tickets.signal: Chiller plant modelled as four systems (A–D). CRAH-to-hall mapping inferred from naming, still to validate against site drawings.
Per-hall model (E-GA first) at row/rack level, beyond what dctwin resolves. Dummy simulation ran 25 Aug.

9 Oct: client asked for the platform, so build it first and wait for data. Missing ~30 CRAH points and all IT load. E+ model complete but uncalibrated; AI policy pre-trained; ingestion mappings deployed.
Not started.
Phase 1 done (10 tickets). Phase 2 data integration in progress; ingestion layer not built yet; a new engineer is joining.

Open since Jul 2025. Jan 2026: "escalate to upper management if still stalled". 72 existing points return data (3 Jun); new points, remote access and VPN bandwidth still open. No maintenance contract with BDx-SIN1.
Mar: AI and baseline looked equal because the baseline setpoint was hard-coded at 14 °C. Scripts updated.
50 of 60 new points OK, 10 return no value. Broken-point list exported to Sherry for an online review meeting.

tickets.summary: [BDX-SIN1] Update the Chiller Plant & E+ model
tickets.signal: Scenario and cookbook updated (L7 roof loop, chiller swap). E+ model with Dr. Xu for check.
Deployed to GCP VM; InfluxDB and cookbook tested. Pending check with Dr. Xu.
28 Sep: E+ model updated; the data dependency that blocked progress is cleared. Data-problem list to go to Liangtao and BDx.

tickets.summary: [CMI-DE1] Prepare deployment — data, frontend & AI integration
tickets.signal: 17 Apr: AI engine integration ~80%; baseline and recommendation run without mocks. No update since June.
Platform layer deployed 5 May; application layer on hold because client data points have degraded since March. Handover note 12 Jul; patched code not yet merged into dcwiz-task-library.
Jun–Aug: chiller and IT power readings flat; client still fixing data. Last note: "to review the data again".
CH-1 water-side COP 1.836 / 1.838 / 1.829 (Jul / Aug / Sep): no leak detectable; an early leak is not ruled out. Report handed to Mingchen for 2 Oct.
Outline: savings on DH-3-01 and DH-3-03, overall chiller savings, CH02 leak status, CH01 recovery.
Created 5 Oct. No description yet.
Waiting on the data-integration upgrade (BA-1846). Untouched since May.

单区 AI 训练工作目标完成日

brief.en: 4 of 4 delivery projects are waiting on client data, not on RDA engineering: models, AI and deployments are being built ahead of the data. Two need leadership now. CMI-DE1 has been on hold for five months with about 20% usable data, and BDx SIN1's data-point ticket has been blocked for 15 months. The next ten days hold two client moments, the CMI-SG renewal visit (around 22 Oct) and DayOne's meeting with Zach (23 Oct), plus one hard date: the BDC platform delivery on 31 Oct. Xu Mingchen carries 10 of 19 open tickets across all 6 projects.
brief.zh: 4 个交付项目中有 4 个在等客户数据,而不是卡在 RDA 工程上:模型、AI 和部署都在数据之前先行搭建。两个项目现在就需要管理层介入:CMI-DE1 因可用数据仅约 20% 已暂停五个月;BDx SIN1 的数据点工单已阻塞 15 个月。未来十天有两个客户关键节点(CMI-SG 续约现场会约 10 月 22 日、DayOne 与 Zach 会面 10 月 23 日),以及一个硬性日期:BDC 平台 10 月 31 日交付。Xu Mingchen 一人承担 19 个在途工单中的 10 个,覆盖全部 6 个项目。

freshness.en: Jira trails the weekly meeting. 5 of 6 projects have material updates in the 12 Oct sync (the CMI-DE1 accuracy figure, BDC's 31 Oct commitment, the CMI-SG renewal) that are not in Jira. Approving them through Meeting To-dos keeps this page honest.
freshness.zh: Jira 落后于周会。6 个项目中有 5 个在 10 月 12 日周会上有重要更新(CMI-DE1 数据准确率、BDC 10 月 31 日承诺、CMI-SG 续约)尚未写入 Jira。通过「会议待办」审批后回写,才能让本页保持准确。
